question: Can exact transfer of the frozen event-blind pitched/harmonic scanner to the CED-VAL-005 controlled full mix generate candidates temporally corresponding to a useful subset of the 356 original Bass observations missed by frozen htdemucs_ft-to-JGA?
SAMPLE_RATE_FRONTEND_ADAPTATION: CED-VAL-006 required deterministic 48 kHz -> 44.1 kHz resampling because its controlled mix was native 48 kHz. CED-VAL-005 is already native 44.1 kHz. The resampling stage is therefore bypassed so that both experiments enter the scientific scanner at the same 44.1 kHz analysis domain.

adaptation_scope.authorized_signal_change: assert native rate == 44100 and return normalized mono native samples without resample_poly
adaptation_scope.non_scientific_metadata_change: candidate protocol_id updated from CEDVAL006 to CEDVAL005

prohibited: musical note or harmonic progression expectations
candidate_firewall.pre_generation_verification: scanner source contains no authority path and no evaluation import; no Bass-reference outcome file opened for candidate generation
candidate_firewall.ordering: two candidate streams must be byte-identical, hashed, and committed before evaluator execution

event_formation.track_link: successive eligible frames separated by no more than two intervening ineligible frames and best F0 change <=70 cents
event_formation.activation: at least 3 eligible linked frames including 3 consecutive scan frames spanning <=35 cents
event_formation.timestamp: analysis-time start of first frame in earliest qualifying stable triple
event_formation.duration: first through last eligible linked frame including one frame duration
event_formation.candidate_set: up to 3 aggregate local maxima >=95% of best and >=35 cents apart
event_formation.duplicate_suppression: within 120 ms retain more eligible frames, then higher score, then earlier timestamp

evaluation.one_to_one: global greedy edges ordered by absolute displacement, earlier candidate, original timestamp, candidate ID, original ID
evaluation.pitch_reference: after candidate lock only, identical +40 to +300 ms method on BassDI

decision_gates.USEFUL_CANDIDATE_RECOVERY: all invariants pass; missed recall >=0.15; precision >=0.30; unmatched/new <=2; median absolute displacement <=0.025 s; >=50% missed-match pitch evaluability and pitch compatibility >=0.50
decision_gates.PARTIAL: all invariants pass; missed recall >=0.05; precision >=0.15; unmatched/new <=5; median absolute displacement <=0.040 s; >=50% evaluability and pitch compatibility >=0.25; without meeting USEFUL
decision_gates.INSUFFICIENT: all invariants pass but PARTIAL is not met
decision_gates.INDETERMINATE: authority, ordering, execution, or replay invariant fails, or when missed matches exist fewer than 50% are pitch-evaluable

scientific_firewall: Temporal correspondence does not establish unique Double Bass identity. No source-specificity conclusion, validated Bass event claim, production union, AD-037/038/040 or RhythmSectionTimingProfile modification, causal swing/material comparison, or Piano-contamination claim.

software.environment: isolated temporary venv referencing unchanged frozen packages; no install
